purpose: Outward requirements and contract only for independent blackbox design; no implementation or development cases
link_policy: Do not follow any links in allowed files. No RFC/backend design/storage implementation/review/development reports/old tests/agents logs/prompt history/CI/app code/private credentials or service inventory. Root freeze manifest itself may be used only as metadata/hash authority, not permission to read its other listed files.
process_policy: Fresh fork_turns=none; no other-agent contact except explicitly published neutral metadata to coordinator.
Shared filesystem is procedural/context isolation, not OS sandbox. Use own worktree/index, ignored private tmp directory and854_ prefix. Do not touch root index or other roles.
Design-only; no application/HTTP/SQL/browser/MQ/CI/load/services/paid resources. Do not infer pass or execute tests.
Private cases, methods and logs stay unreadable to coordinator/developers; only explicitly published metadata may be read. Do not push private content.
Executable tool/environment must later be independently frozen, then exact SUT/environment and bounded execution explicitly admitted.
Only true execution results may be reported; AI is never student manual authorship.
